parameters.name: q
parameters.value: ={{ (() => { const c = $('Select Rows').item.json; const addrs = c.testMode ? c.sendTo.split(', ') : c.sendTo.split(', ').concat(c.cc ? c.cc.split(', ') : []); return '{from:mailer-daemon from:postmaster}' + (() => { try { const ms = Number($('Gmail - Get Thread').item.json.messages[0].internalDate); return ms > 0 ? ' after:' + Math.floor(ms / 1000) : ''; } catch (e) { return ''; } })() + ' {' + addrs.map(a => '"' + a + '"').join(' ') + '}'; })() }}

parameters.amount: ={{ (() => { const s = $('Settings').first().json; return Math.round(s.MIN_DELAY_S + Math.random() * (s.MAX_DELAY_S - s.MIN_DELAY_S)); })() }}
